experiment: MEES-EXT-3 external structural bridge on untouched CausaLab 6nodes_freqparent suite
development_history: v1.1 minimality certification was frozen before EXT-2.
EXT-2 FAIL only H2 under mean-per-applicable-graph substitution F1; post-hoc pooled pair F1 was 0.923077.
EXT-1 and EXT-2 remain FAIL and are not re-scored.

external_source.selection_rule: fixed 10 indices committed before opening any record in this suite

task_definition.candidate_nodes: all non-target nodes with is_controllable=true and observable=true
task_definition.disturbance_roots: candidate nodes with graph indegree zero that have a directed path to target
task_definition.positive_mask: removing/fixing selected candidates destroys every directed path from every unselected disturbance root to target
task_definition.note: target may have outgoing edges in FreqParent; only directed paths INTO the target define shielding.

budget_rule: native record intervention budget, capped at 2^n masks

metrics.minimal_sets: per-record exact-set F1, averaged across 10 records
metrics.substitutions: pooled pair precision, recall, and F1 across all records with graph_id namespace

preregistered_hypotheses.H5_relative: MEES mean minimal_set_F1 exceeds best baseline by >= 0.15
preregistered_hypotheses.H6_efficiency: MEES never exceeds native intervention budget
preregistered_hypotheses.H7_worst: MEES minimal_set_F1 >= 0.50 on at least 8 of 10 records

verdict_rule: PASS only if H1-H7 all pass.
stop_rule: If EXT-3 fails, do not tune on this suite and reuse it for confirmation.
interpretation_guardrails: This remains a derived structural bridge, not native CausaLab graph-recovery scoring.
A PASS would support external transfer of minimal-set/substitution search only.
A PASS would not validate phase mapping or general causal discovery.
